full.instruction:
Write a story about Tom that uses the words: dark, must, close.
Story:
full.story:
One day, a boy named Tom found a flashlight. He liked to play with it. He would turn it on and off, and it would make a fun sound. Tom's friend, Sam, saw the flashlight and wanted to play with it too. But Tom did not want to share. This made Sam very sad.
Sam's mom saw them and had an idea. She told them, "If you share the flashlight, I will give you a tasty treat." Tom and Sam thought about it and agreed. They took turns playing with the flashlight, and the treat was very tasty.
After they played for a while, they both felt tired. They decided to close the flashlight and go to sleep. When they woke up, they saw a big mess. They felt regret for not sharing the flashlight. Tom's mom helped them clean up the mess. Tom and Sam learned that sharing is good and makes everyone happy.

full.story:
Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom liked to stretch his legs and play with his ball. One day, Tom saw a big dog named Max. Max was a guard dog.
Tom said to Max, "Hi! Do you want to play with me?" Max said, "Yes! Let's play with your ball." They played and had fun. But then, the ball went far away. Tom and Max ran to find the ball.
As they ran, they saw a big box. The box was moving! Tom and Max were scared. But then, the box opened, and out came a lot of balls! The balls were for all the animals to play with. Tom and Max were happy and played with the new balls all day.

lora16.instruction:
Write a story about Tom that uses the words: dark, must, close.
Story:
lora16.story:
One day, a boy named Tom found a big, old box in his room. He did not know what was inside. He was very excited to open it. He ran to his mom and said, "Mom, can I open this old box?"
His mom looked at the box and said, "Yes, Tom, you can open the box. But be careful, it might be something bad."
Tom opened the box and found a toy car inside. He was very happy. He played with the car all day. But then, he dropped the car and it broke. Tom was sad and scared.
His mom came into the room and saw the broken car. She said, "Tom, I told you to be careful. Now, the car is broken and you must be more careful next time."
Tom learned that he should listen to his mom and be careful with things that are not his. He promised to be more careful next time.

When Lucy got to her birthday party, she saw a big box. She was curious to see what was inside. She opened the box and found a toy bear. Lucy loved the bear and wanted to play with it.
Lucy and the bear played together all day. They played games, ate cake, and had a great time. Lucy was happy that she had a new friend to play with. And they lived happily ever after.

Story:
lora16.story:
One day, a cat named Tom was very tired. He wanted to take a nap. He saw a big tree and thought it would be a good place to sleep.
Tom said, "I will stretch and stretch." He started to stretch his legs. But then, a dog named Max came. Max said, "No, Tom! You are too tired to stretch. You will fall."
Tom was sad. He did not want to fall. But Max was right. Tom decided to listen to Max. He said, "Okay, Max. I will wait."
Tom and Max became friends. They played together and had fun. Soon, Tom was not tired anymore. He stretched and played with Max.

lora4.story:
One day, a boy named Tom found a big, old box in his room. He opened the box and saw a small, old ashtray. It was round and shiny. Tom did not know what it was, so he asked his mom.
"Mom, what is this?" Tom said. His mom looked at the ashtray and said, "That is an ashtray, Tom. It is where people put their cigarettes."
Tom wanted to know more about the ashtray. He asked his mom to explain. "The cigaretttes can be very old and not safe for us to touch. We should put it back in the box and close it."
His mom agreed and they put the ashtray back in the box. Tom felt happy that he could help his mom understand. He went back to play with his toys, knowing that the old ashtray was safe and important.

Write a story about Tom that uses the words: stretch, woke, start.
Story:
lora1.story:
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom had a big, soft pillow. He loved his pillow very much. Every day, Tom would stretch his arms and legs to reach the pillow.
One day, Tom felt very tired. He yawned and said, "I need a nap." So, Tom went to his soft pillow and laid down. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
While Tom was sleeping, the pillow started to stretch. It stretched up, up, up into the air! Tom woke up and saw his pillow stretching. He said, "Wow! My pillow can stretch!" Tom laughed and continued to stretch his arms and legs. He had a fun nap with his pillow.
